ex.en: I log in to Tatoeba once a week.
ex.zh: 我每週登入 Tatoeba 一次。

ex.en: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
ex.zh: 登出後再登入需要密碼。

ex.en: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
ex.zh: 鞋子最合理的擺放位置是門口附近。

ex.en: What you're saying isn't logical.
ex.zh: 你說的話不合邏輯。

ex.en: This seems logical to me.
ex.zh: 我覺得這很合理。

ex.en: I have a friend waiting for me in the lobby.
ex.zh: 有個朋友在大廳等我。

ex.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
ex.zh: 晚上六點半在帝國飯店大廳和我碰面。

ex.en: The industry lobbied the government to lower taxes.
ex.zh: 業界遊說政府降低稅率。

ex.en: Several groups are lobbying for stricter safety rules.
ex.zh: 好幾個團體正在遊說制定更嚴格的安全規定。

ex.en: We waited in the airport lounge.
ex.zh: 我們在機場貴賓室等候。

ex.en: There is a staff lounge on the third floor.
ex.zh: 三樓有員工休息室。

ex.en: We lounged by the pool all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊悠閒地躺著。

ex.en: He was lounging on the sofa watching TV.
ex.zh: 他懶洋洋地躺在沙發上看電視。

ex.en: To whom are you loyal: me or the king?
ex.zh: 你效忠的是誰？我還是國王？

ex.en: We want to reward our loyal customers.
ex.zh: 我們想回饋忠實顧客。

ex.en: He has been a loyal employee for 20 years.
ex.zh: 他在公司忠心服務了二十年。

ex.en: Think globally, act locally.
ex.zh: 放眼全球，在地行動。

ex.en: We try to buy vegetables locally.
ex.zh: 我們盡量在本地買蔬菜。

ex.en: All our products are made locally.
ex.zh: 我們所有產品都是在地製造的。

ex.en: While swimming in the pool, she lost her locker key.
ex.zh: 她在游泳池游泳時弄丟了置物櫃鑰匙。

ex.en: Each student has a locker.
ex.zh: 每個學生都有一個置物櫃。

ex.en: Tom left a note in Mary's locker.
ex.zh: 湯姆在瑪麗的置物櫃裡留了一張紙條。

ex.en: The players sat in the locker room while they listened to their coach speak.
ex.zh: 球員坐在更衣室裡聽教練講話。

ex.en: I left my bag in the locker room.
ex.zh: 我把包包留在更衣室了。

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly after his speech.
ex.zh: 他演講結束後，觀眾熱烈鼓掌。

ex.en: You don't have to speak so loudly.
ex.zh: 你不必講這麼大聲。

ex.en: Could you speak a little less loudly?
ex.zh: 可以請你說話小聲一點嗎？

ex.en: The deadline is looming, so we need to hurry.
ex.zh: 截止日期快到了，我們得加快腳步。

ex.en: With exams looming, Amy studied every night.
ex.zh: 考試迫在眉睫，Amy 每晚都在讀書。

ex.en: A huge ship loomed out of the fog.
ex.zh: 一艘巨大的船從霧中隱約出現。

ex.en: Dark mountains loomed in the distance.
ex.zh: 遠方隱約可見黑壓壓的山。

ex.en: I'm a loser.
ex.zh: 我是個失敗者。

ex.en: The loser of the game has to buy dinner.
ex.zh: 比賽輸的人要請吃晚餐。

ex.en: Both companies may end up as losers in this price war.
ex.zh: 這場價格戰可能讓兩家公司都成為輸家。

loop.zh: keep sb in the loop：讓某人隨時掌握最新狀況

ex.en: Please keep me in the loop about the project.
ex.zh: 專案有任何進展請隨時讓我知道。

ex.en: Sorry, I wasn't in the loop on that decision.
ex.zh: 抱歉，那個決定我事先並不知情。

loop.zh: loop sb in：把某人加進來（郵件、討論）

ex.en: Let me loop in my manager on this email.
ex.zh: 我把主管加進這封郵件裡。

ex.en: I've looped Amy in so she can help.
ex.zh: 我已經把 Amy 拉進來，讓她幫忙。

ex.en: The highway forms a loop around the city.
ex.zh: 這條公路環繞城市一圈。

ex.en: The program is stuck in an infinite loop.
ex.zh: 程式卡在無窮迴圈裡了。

ex.en: Look at this picture.
ex.zh: 看看這張照片。

ex.en: Please look at the screen.
ex.zh: 請看螢幕。

ex.en: It looks as if it is going to rain.
ex.zh: 看起來快要下雨了。

ex.en: The house looked good; moreover, the price was right.
ex.zh: 這房子看起來不錯，而且價格也合理。

ex.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
ex.zh: 「這就是我在找的東西！」他大叫。

ex.en: I'm looking for a new job.
ex.zh: 我正在找新工作。

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快收到你的回音。

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you again very soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快能再見到你。

ex.en: Can I have a look at your report?
ex.zh: 我可以看一下你的報告嗎？

ex.en: Take a look at this.
ex.zh: 你看一下這個。

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: The Yangtze, at 6,380 km, is Asia's longest river.
ex.zh: 長江全長6,380公里，是亞洲最長的河流。

ex.en: How long have you worked here?
ex.zh: 你在這裡工作多久了？

ex.en: I won't stay long.
ex.zh: 我不會待太久。

ex.en: He no longer works here.
ex.zh: 他已經不在這裡工作了。

ex.en: This product is no longer available.
ex.zh: 這項產品已經不再供應。

ex.en: As long as you finish on time, it's fine.
ex.zh: 只要你準時完成就沒問題。

ex.en: You can borrow my car as long as you drive carefully.
ex.zh: 只要你小心開，就可以借我的車。

ex.en: We are all longing for peace in the world.
ex.zh: 我們都渴望世界和平。

ex.en: She longed to see her family again.
ex.zh: 她渴望再見到家人。

lot.zh: a lot of / lots of：許多

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
ex.zh: 學好外語需要很大的耐心。

ex.en: Bob has a lot of books in his room.
ex.zh: 鮑伯房間裡有很多書。

ex.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
ex.zh: 很多公司實施了八小時工作制。

ex.en: Thanks a lot.
ex.zh: 非常感謝。

ex.en: She travels a lot for work.
ex.zh: 她常常因為工作出差。

ex.en: I parked in the lot behind the building.
ex.zh: 我把車停在大樓後面的停車場。

ex.en: The parking lot is full.
ex.zh: 停車場滿了。

ex.en: No one knows whether he loves her or not.
ex.zh: 沒人知道他到底愛不愛她。

ex.en: Tom wanted Mary to say that she loved him.
ex.zh: 湯姆希望瑪麗說她愛他。

ex.en: Loving to work is the key to happiness.
ex.zh: 熱愛工作是幸福的關鍵。

ex.en: I love Taiwanese food.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡台灣菜。

ex.en: The prince fell in love with a woodcutter's daughter.
ex.zh: 王子愛上了樵夫的女兒。

ex.en: At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.
ex.zh: 最後，馬力歐終於贏得了公主的愛。

ex.en: I'd love to come to your party.
ex.zh: 我很樂意參加你的派對。

ex.en: We would love to work with you.
ex.zh: 我們很希望能與您合作。

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他的薪水太低，買不起那間房子。

ex.en: The shower head in this shower is too low.
ex.zh: 這個淋浴間的蓮蓬頭太低了。

ex.en: The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.
ex.zh: 阿爾卑斯山在義大利那一側通常比較低。

ex.en: The stock price hit a new low.
ex.zh: 股價創下新低。

ex.en: Sales reached a record low last month.
ex.zh: 上個月的銷售額跌到歷史新低。

ex.en: I suggest we move to a safer location.
ex.zh: 我建議我們移到比較安全的地方。

ex.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
ex.zh: 開在那個地點的書店賺的錢不夠撐下去。

ex.en: A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
ex.zh: GPS 裝置能在世界任何地方精確找出你的位置。

ex.en: The company is located in the suburbs of Boston.
ex.zh: 這家公司位於波士頓郊區。

ex.en: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
ex.zh: 大使館就在最高法院旁邊。

ex.en: I can't locate the source of the problem.
ex.zh: 我找不到問題的根源。

ex.en: We're having difficulty locating Tom.
ex.zh: 我們很難找到湯姆。

ex.en: The bats use ultrasound to locate obstacles.
ex.zh: 蝙蝠利用超音波找出障礙物的位置。

lovely.zh: 可愛的、漂亮的；令人愉快的

ex.en: There are four lovely children in this photo.
ex.zh: 這張照片裡有四個可愛的孩子。

ex.en: It was a lovely autumn evening.
ex.zh: 那是個美好的秋天傍晚。

ex.en: Look at that lovely house of Mary's.
ex.zh: 看看瑪麗那棟漂亮的房子。

ex.en: I remember locking the door.
ex.zh: 我記得有鎖門。

ex.en: Please make sure that the door is locked.
ex.zh: 請確認門已經鎖好。

ex.en: Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
ex.zh: 因為大門鎖著，我們進不了屋子。

ex.en: I need to change the lock on my door.
ex.zh: 我需要換門鎖。

ex.en: The key won't turn in the lock.
ex.zh: 鑰匙在鎖裡轉不動。

lock.zh: lock oneself out：把自己鎖在門外

ex.en: I locked myself out of my apartment again.
ex.zh: 我又把自己鎖在公寓門外了。

ex.en: If you lock yourself out, call the front desk.
ex.zh: 如果被鎖在門外，請打給櫃檯。

ex.en: She wore a long, loose coat.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件寬鬆的長外套。

ex.en: The original qipao was wide and loose.
ex.zh: 最初的旗袍又寬又鬆。

ex.en: This button is loose.
ex.zh: 這顆鈕扣鬆了。

ex.en: One of the screws on the chair is loose.
ex.zh: 椅子上有一顆螺絲鬆了。

log.zh: log in / log out：登入／登出

ex.en: I shouldn't have logged off.
ex.zh: 我不應該登出的。

ex.en: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
ex.zh: 登出後要再登入需要密碼。

ex.en: Keep a log of all customer calls.
ex.zh: 把所有客戶來電都記錄下來。

ex.en: Check the error log to find the problem.
ex.zh: 查看錯誤日誌來找出問題。

ex.en: The writer is living in a log cabin.
ex.zh: 那位作家住在一間小木屋裡。

ex.en: We put another log on the fire.
ex.zh: 我們又往火裡加了一根木頭。

ex.en: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.
ex.zh: 我爸爸說話總是很大聲。

ex.en: It's noisy around here, so speak a little louder.
ex.zh: 這裡很吵，請說大聲一點。

ex.en: Tom was trying hard not to laugh out loud.
ex.zh: 湯姆拚命忍著不笑出聲來。

ex.en: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
ex.zh: 我突然很想放聲大哭。

ex.en: I cannot follow your logic.
ex.zh: 我跟不上你的邏輯。

ex.en: I can't follow his logic.
ex.zh: 我無法理解他的邏輯。

ex.en: The logic behind this decision is simple.
ex.zh: 這個決定背後的邏輯很簡單。

ex.en: He is a lover of sports.
ex.zh: 他是個運動愛好者。

ex.en: I am a theatre lover.
ex.zh: 我是個戲劇愛好者。

ex.en: This café is popular with coffee lovers.
ex.zh: 這家咖啡廳很受咖啡愛好者歡迎。

ex.en: The two lovers swore to love each other for eternity.
ex.zh: 兩個戀人發誓永遠相愛。

ex.en: The film tells the story of two young lovers.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述一對年輕戀人的故事。

ex.en: The city became the locus of the tech industry.
ex.zh: 這座城市成為科技產業的重鎮。

ex.en: The kitchen is the locus of family life in our house.
ex.zh: 在我們家，廚房是家庭生活的中心。

longitudinal.zh: 長期追蹤的（研究）；縱向的

ex.en: This longitudinal study followed 1,000 children for 20 years.
ex.zh: 這項長期追蹤研究追蹤了一千名兒童二十年。

ex.en: Longitudinal data shows how habits change over time.
ex.zh: 長期追蹤資料顯示習慣如何隨時間改變。

ex.en: Please enter your login and password.
ex.zh: 請輸入你的帳號和密碼。

ex.en: The login page keeps showing an error message.
ex.zh: 登入頁面一直出現錯誤訊息。

ex.en: The board approved a long-range plan for overseas expansion.
ex.zh: 董事會核准了一項海外擴張的長期計畫。

ex.en: Long-range forecasts suggest demand will keep rising.
ex.zh: 長期預測顯示需求會持續成長。

ex.en: The company is located in the suburbs of Boston.
ex.zh: 這家公司位於波士頓的郊區。

ex.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
ex.zh: 這間飯店位置很好，搭大眾運輸很方便。

ex.en: Life vests are located under your seats.
ex.zh: 救生衣位於您的座位下方。

ex.en: The customer lodged a complaint with the manager.
ex.zh: 那位顧客向經理提出申訴。

ex.en: You can lodge an appeal within thirty days.
ex.zh: 你可以在三十天內提出上訴。

ex.en: We stayed at a ski lodge in the mountains.
ex.zh: 我們住在山上的一間滑雪小屋。

ex.en: The lodge offers guided hiking tours.
ex.zh: 這間山莊提供有導覽的健行行程。

ex.en: We lodged with a local family during the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行期間我們借住在當地人家裡。

ex.en: A piece of food got lodged in his throat.
ex.zh: 一塊食物卡在他的喉嚨裡。

ex.en: This building is a capsule hotel lodging men and women.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是男女都可以住宿的膠囊旅館。

ex.en: The company will pay for your travel and lodging.
ex.zh: 公司會支付你的交通和住宿費用。

ex.en: It was hard to find lodging during the festival.
ex.zh: 節慶期間很難找到住宿。

ex.en: He is a very loving person.
ex.zh: 他是一個很有愛心的人。

ex.en: Layla was very outgoing, loving, and caring.
ex.zh: 萊拉很外向、有愛心、會照顧人。

ex.en: She grew up in a warm and loving family.
ex.zh: 她在一個溫暖又充滿愛的家庭中長大。

ex.en: When I don't have my cell phone, I feel lonely.
ex.zh: 我沒有我的手機的時候會感到很孤獨。

ex.en: To tell you the truth, I'm feeling lonely.
ex.zh: 說實話，我感到孤獨。

ex.en: This city is cold and lonely without you.
ex.zh: 沒有你這個城市孤單又冷清。

ex.en: Everyone loves the lovable old dog next door.
ex.zh: 每個人都喜歡隔壁那隻討人喜愛的老狗。

ex.en: He is a lovable boy with a big smile.
ex.zh: 他是個笑容燦爛、討人喜歡的男孩。

ex.en: The old man felt lonesome after his wife passed away.
ex.zh: 老先生在妻子過世後覺得很寂寞。

ex.en: A lonesome tree stood on the hill.
ex.zh: 山丘上孤零零地立著一棵樹。

ex.en: That's the thing about people who think they hate computers. What they really hate is lousy programmers.
ex.zh: 那些自認為討厭電腦的人就是這麼回事。他們真正討厭的是差勁的程式設計師。

ex.en: I had a lousy night's sleep because of the noise.
ex.zh: 因為噪音，我昨晚睡得很糟。

ex.en: The food at that restaurant is lousy.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的食物很難吃。

ex.en: Can you put some suntan lotion on my back?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我在背上擦些防曬乳嗎？

ex.en: Put some lotion on your hands if your skin feels dry.
ex.zh: 皮膚覺得乾的話，就在手上擦點乳液。

ex.en: The doctor gave me a lotion for the itchy rash.
ex.zh: 醫生開了一瓶外用藥水給我擦發癢的疹子。

ex.en: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
ex.zh: 我們往車裡裝了很多行李。

ex.en: The man is loading the moving truck on his own.
ex.zh: 那個男人自己一個人把東西搬上搬家卡車。

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車最大載重量是 5 噸。

ex.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
ex.zh: 貨車的載貨量超過三噸。

ex.en: The website still loads.
ex.zh: 網站還在載入中。

ex.en: The page takes a long time to load.
ex.zh: 這個網頁載入要很久。

ex.en: The company uses a logistics partner to deliver its products.
ex.zh: 公司透過物流夥伴配送產品。

ex.en: She works in logistics for a shipping company.
ex.zh: 她在一家航運公司做物流。

ex.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.
ex.zh: 外行人談戰略，內行人談後勤。

ex.en: We need to plan the logistics of the conference.
ex.zh: 我們需要規劃研討會的後勤安排。

ex.en: You can withdraw money from ATMs that have the "UnionPay" logo.
ex.zh: 你可以在有「銀聯」標誌的提款機領錢。

ex.en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
ex.zh: 側邊欄顯示在網站標誌下方的頁面邊緣。

ex.en: The company rewards customer loyalty with discounts.
ex.zh: 公司用折扣回饋忠實顧客。

ex.en: His loyalty to his friends is admirable.
ex.zh: 他對朋友的忠誠令人欽佩。

ex.en: You can get a loan from a bank.
ex.zh: 你可以從銀行貸款。

ex.en: Interest on loans is high at present.
ex.zh: 目前的貸款利率很高。

ex.en: I do not need a loan anymore.
ex.zh: 我不需要貸款了。

ex.en: Tom asked Mary to loan him some money.
ex.zh: 湯姆問瑪麗能不能借他一些錢。

ex.en: Could you loan me your car for the weekend?
ex.zh: 週末可以把車借我嗎？

ex.en: Their losses reached one million yen.
ex.zh: 他們的損失達到一百萬日圓。

ex.en: The company suffered big losses.
ex.zh: 公司遭受了巨大的損失。

ex.en: His death was a great loss to our firm.
ex.zh: 他的過世對我們公司是一大損失。

ex.en: I was at a loss as to what to say.
ex.zh: 我不知道該說什麼。

ex.en: Tom was at a loss how to express himself.
ex.zh: 湯姆不知道該怎麼表達自己。

ex.en: Localization made the app easier for local users to navigate.
ex.zh: 在地化讓當地使用者更容易操作這款應用程式。

ex.en: The team handles product localization for each market.
ex.zh: 團隊負責各市場的產品在地化。

ex.en: The museum restored a steam locomotive from the 1920s.
ex.zh: 博物館修復了一輛 1920 年代的蒸汽火車頭。

ex.en: A powerful locomotive pulled the freight train uphill.
ex.zh: 一輛大馬力火車頭牽引貨運列車爬坡。

ex.en: I think we're lost. Let's ask someone.
ex.zh: 我想我們迷路了，找個人問問吧。

ex.en: She got lost in the old town.
ex.zh: 她在老城區迷路了。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這支筆跟我昨天弄丟的那支一樣。

ex.en: I finally found my lost keys under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我終於在沙發底下找到弄丟的鑰匙。

ex.en: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
ex.zh: 近幾年，很多當地的傳統都衰敗了。

ex.en: Tom took part in a local bike race.
ex.zh: 湯姆參加了當地的一場自行車比賽。

ex.en: The goat's milk that Mark sells is very popular among the locals.
ex.zh: 馬克賣的羊奶在當地人中很受歡迎。

ex.en: The locals call this river the man-eating river and fear it.
ex.zh: 當地人把這條河叫做「吃人河」，對它很畏懼。

ex.en: I lost my wallet on the train.
ex.zh: 我在火車上把錢包弄丟了。

ex.en: Don't lose your boarding pass.
ex.zh: 別把登機證弄丟了。

ex.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.
ex.zh: 100萬人在戰爭中失去了生命。

ex.en: We were in danger of losing our lives.
ex.zh: 我們差點喪命。

ex.en: Our team lost the game by two points.
ex.zh: 我們隊以兩分之差輸了比賽。

ex.en: I hate losing at cards.
ex.zh: 我很討厭打牌輸。

ex.en: I want to know how I can lose weight.
ex.zh: 我想知道要怎麼減重。

ex.en: She lost a lot of weight after she started running.
ex.zh: 她開始跑步之後瘦了很多。

ex.en: Where is the nearest lost and found?
ex.zh: 離這裡最近的失物招領處在哪裡？

ex.en: Where is the lost and found?
ex.zh: 失物招領處在哪兒？
